# Embedding Providers

This module provides various embedding provider classes, such as OpenAIEmbedder and AzureOpenAIEmbedder, which utilize predefined models to convert texts into vectors. It also includes a FakeEmbedder for testing purposes that generates deterministic embeddings based on text content hashes.
